question: In the meter bridge arrangement shown, the resistance in the left gap is X and in the right gap is Y. The balance point is obtained at l = 40 cm from the left end. Due to end effects (contact/lead resistance), the bridge wire has an effective additional length of +2 cm at the 0 cm end and +1 cm at the 100 cm end. (i) Find the true ratio X/Y. (ii) If end correction is neglected, the ratio obtained is smaller than the true value by what percentage (approximately)? (iii) If X and Y are interchanged (same end corrections), at what length l' will the new balance point be obtained? Choose the correct set.
